description: This file defines the LogNode interface used for implementing a chain of log handlers in an Android logging system. It provides a method to output log messages, potentially passing them along the chain.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for logging nodes in a chain, responsible for outputting log messages and optionally passing them further.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with the specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
